Name: Fix Android 14 photo upload NullPointerException crash
Description:
Fix the top Android crasher affecting ~4% of Android sessions. Issue is a NullPointerException in the media picker callback triggered when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Start a photo upload. 2) Background the app before the upload finishes. 3) Return to the app.

Owner: Marcus to implement the fix. Sam to verify on Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run.

Acceptance criteria: Fix landed and verified by Wednesday (before the sprint's August 20 release) so QA has time to confirm. No crash on backgrounding/foregrounding during photo upload on Android 14.

Name: Build backend sync API for offline notes list
Description:
Implement the backend sync endpoint for offline notes support promised to enterprise customers last quarter.

Requirements: Client sends its last-synced timestamp; server returns a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution policy is last-write-wins for this pass (no merge UI).

Owner: Elena.

Acceptance criteria: Endpoint returns correct deltas based on the provided last-synced timestamp. Must be in code review before Elena's OOO days (August 17-18).

Name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
Description:
Implement the mobile client side of offline notes support.

Requirements: Local cache in Room; queue writes while offline; replay queued writes when connectivity returns. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins (no merge UI).

Owner: Marcus.

Acceptance criteria: Write the acceptance criteria into the ticket. User can open the app in airplane mode, view notes, edit them, and all changes reconcile with no data loss when back online.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
Description:
Migrate build, test, and release pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. A proof of concept for the build job already exists.

Scope this sprint: Finish test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week, then turn Jenkins off only if the parallel week is clean.

Owner: Sam.

Acceptance criteria: Build, test, and release pipelines running in GitHub Actions. Nightly builds preserved. Jenkins kept alive until the parallel run week is verified clean. Payments regression tests integrated into the new pipeline.

Name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
Description:
Address the search endpoint degradation incident caused by a misbehaving script by adding per-user rate limiting.

Requirements: Limit of 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when the limit is exceeded. Add a metrics counter to identify users hitting the limit.

Owner: Elena.

Acceptance criteria: Requests beyond 100/min/user receive HTTP 429 with Retry-After header. Metrics counter exposes which users are being rate limited.

Name: Update consent screen for GDPR compliance
Description:
Update the privacy policy/consent screen to meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. This is a launch blocker for the August 20 release.

Requirements: Obtain updated copy from legal. Rebuild the consent screen with opt-in toggles. Provide separate toggles for analytics consent and marketing consent. Nothing should be pre-checked.

Owner: Marcus.

Acceptance criteria: New legal-approved copy in place. Two separate opt-in toggles (analytics, marketing), neither pre-checked. Must ship in the August 20 mobile release.

Name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
Description:
Add automated test coverage for the payments flow, which currently has none and caused issues in the last release.

Coverage required: purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path.

Owner: Sam.

Acceptance criteria: Regression tests for all four paths written and running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
